sources.E: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list
sources.O: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List guide (Nov 19, 2026)

trophies.guide: This one lands on its own the moment the other 54 are yours (Exophase). Plan around roughly 200 hours: the story is the short part, and the counters plus the 100% checklist eat the clock (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the tutorial and cannot be skipped (Exophase). From here on, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission (Exophase). Before the final one, use the Chapter 1 morning at Jason's house: follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate (see Positive Mental Attitude) — that moment exists only in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 (Exophase). Partway through, Jason and Lucia both become playable, which switches on the partner trophies (Output Lag).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 (Exophase). The Race Against Yago strand appears in this chapter and is time-sensitive (Output Lag), and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun that Sneakthief needs (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 (Exophase). Near its end, clear the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — it unlocks the bank vaults (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Save manually in a fresh slot immediately before the final mission — with no mission replay, that save is your only clean way back (PowerPyx). The trophy lands when the final mission ends (Exophase).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 (Exophase). Story missions cannot be missed: a bad run simply retries the checkpoint (Exophase).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3, a set-piece on the critical path (Exophase). It cannot be skipped or locked out, and failures retry from checkpoints (Exophase).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4 (Exophase). It sits on the critical path, and checkpoint retries cover any failure (Exophase).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish Headliners in Chapter 4, part of the main sequence (Exophase). Nothing here is missable, and checkpoints retry any failure (Exophase).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown late in the story (Exophase). While you are at the airport, note gates E3 and E4 — a passenger jet at a boarding bridge there is what Catch Me If You Can needs (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a late-game set piece on the critical path (Exophase). Keep the manual save you made at its chapter's start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: After the credits, open Progress > Stats for the game's own 100% checklist (Output Lag). It asks for about 60% of true completion: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 vehicles scanned and 100 animals studied (PowerPyx). Some categories must be finished in full: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests (PowerPyx). PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy in the game (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Take every ramp, rooftop and drawbridge you pass from the first hour — stunt jumps bank permanently (Output Lag). The trophy wants 250; the 100% checklist separately wants 300, so keep going after this pops (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of each of the nine activity types — races, fishing, drone events, range challenges and the rest (Output Lag). You only have to try each once, not win (Exophase).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Work the range's 42 challenges weapon class by weapon class; gold means accuracy under the clock (Output Lag). The ranges must also be completed in full for the 100% checklist (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone courses and only a win at each one counts (Exophase). Run a new course once to learn its gates, then rerun it while the line is fresh (Output Lag). Drone Races are a must-complete category on the 100% checklist (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Re-winning the same race adds nothing: move to fresh race markers until 20 different events are won (Output Lag). Where the rules allow, bring a car a class above the field (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Enter a fishing challenge against Cal and out-catch him before the clock ends (Exophase). Practise on ordinary spots first, and take the challenge on a calm morning (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Walk up to any arcade cabinet and play one game through to completion (Exophase). Pick the shortest cabinet in the room (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's strand through to its final mission (Exophase). Andy's strand is Lucia-only (PowerPyx). Strand finales stay available after the credits, so there is no deadline on this one (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's strand to its final mission (Exophase). It stays on the map after the credits, so finish it whenever it suits the run (Output Lag).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission (Exophase). Nothing in the strand expires, and the finales make ideal filler between counter grinds (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger strands (Exophase). One warning: the Chapter 3 strand Race Against Yago is time-sensitive — the moment it appears, drop everything and run it (Output Lag). Hourglass-marked quests can expire, but they do not count toward trophies (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: See Randy's strand through to its final mission (Exophase). It stays available after the credits (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission (Exophase). Tyrone's strand is Jason-only (PowerPyx). The strand finales batch neatly into one post-credits sweep (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 18 spots across 10 locations; meditate with both characters where a spot allows it (PowerPyx). THE MISSABLE: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and meditate before Chapter 1 ends (PowerPyx). PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that meditation is required, but it costs a minute to do (PowerPyx). The final spot needs both characters, so it opens only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx). Push Square reports no known missables; we flag this one anyway (Push Square).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and track the unique animal he names (Exophase). Bret's content is Jason-only (PowerPyx). Follow his markers and prepare before the final approach (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collect every card in three full trading-card sets (Exophase). Cards hide on rooftops, pier ends, back rooms and lookout points — finish one set fully before spreading thin (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Make it a habit from the first hour: every time you arrive somewhere new, use WAiNK It on the Point of Interest (Output Lag). As a reflex it fills itself; as an endgame grind it crawls (Output Lag).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Work the Challenges list from the easy categories upward; 50 banks the trophy (Output Lag). The 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80, so the ten hardest can be skipped (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Partner trophies only count with Jason and Lucia together, from Chapter 2 (Output Lag). Raise a 4-star wanted level and lose it properly: break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick three shops close together on the same street, partner beside you, and rob them in one unbroken run — the wanted level must never fully clear between shops (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: A model counts the first time you drive it (Output Lag). Rich districts plus airport and marina parking are the fastest hunting grounds (Output Lag). The trophy wants 100; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming (Output Lag). Trigger it mid gang operation with five or more enemies in one sightline and drop five before the meter empties (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to gates E3 or E4 at VCIA, steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding bridge, and take off (Output Lag). No chase to survive and no destination matters (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Drive to Mile Zero Air Station in the far southwest, where Rhino tanks patrol (Output Lag). The game's own description is the hint: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' (Exophase). Heavy weapons and distance are your friends (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Jewelry robberies unlock in the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun (Output Lag). Use it on Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds' back door, read the safe-code note, and empty the safe without raising the alarm (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Vaults stay locked until the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4, opens them (Output Lag). Then rob five vaults and escape each time (Exophase).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on its route, stop it, crack the rear doors, take the cash, then break away and stay gone until the wanted level clears (Output Lag).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Pass through all 52 named areas — the map registers each one as you enter (Output Lag). Chase the grey patches when crossing the state, and leave a plane or boat sweep for the water areas (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations, and one robbery against each is the whole ask (Output Lag). Vary your targets from the start — the 100% checklist eventually demands the operations in full (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and take it in with the ocean in front of you (Exophase). A pure moment trophy: no skill, no timer, made for a Chapter 1 evening (Output Lag).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive straight out through the glass (Exophase). Any showroom with a car on the floor works (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description is the game's own hint: 'Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley' (Exophase). PowerPyx reads it as stealing three valuables inside the alley (PowerPyx). Unconfirmed — no guide has verified the method yet.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The game's own hint is 'A partnership with mass appeal' (Exophase). The guides disagree, so both readings are printed: PowerPyx reads it as maxing Strength on both characters (PowerPyx); Push Square reads it as reaching max body fat, the Overweight build (Push Square). Neither is confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The game quietly counts your choices and actions toward 500, and ordinary play fills it — missions, strands, robberies, activities (Output Lag). The description reads 'Choices made (for better or worse)'; PowerPyx warns the Irredeemable profile choice cannot be undone once made (PowerPyx). Do not grind it; check it late (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The precise trigger is not yet pinned down by any guide (Output Lag). The description points at failing once and succeeding the second time — 'Second time's the charm' (Exophase) — so retry a failed challenge, race or minigame until you clear it (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What triggers this one is not yet pinned down (Output Lag). The wording — 'What the hell just happened?' (Exophase) — points at witnessing some scripted strangeness out in Leonida; explore the odd corners of the map and finish what you find (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Drive slowly past someone on foot and swing a melee attack from the vehicle as you pass — the hit must connect from the moving car (Output Lag). PowerPyx reads the target as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds (PowerPyx). Unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Feed marked bills to your laundering contacts until $250,000 has come out clean (Exophase). Heist payouts and vault scores are the richest source of marked bills (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across any shops — every till counts (Exophase). The eight garages alone run to roughly $160,000, so this pops on its own partway through buying property (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Open the Vice City Real Estate app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, and buy all eight garages — roughly $160,000 in total (Output Lag). Buy as the money arrives rather than saving for a spree (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app opens through the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Output Lag). After that, register ten vehicles to it as you acquire them (Exophase).
trophies.name: On the Spot
